answer: A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the canyon graph. Re-attestations are stored in mesa and nadir lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 4 peers re-attest it every 20 epochs, so holding a position calls for ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1122 impostors cost 720 times the honest price and take 7 times as long to clear. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
